product.title: Puerto Morelos City & Taco Tour with Tequila Tasting from Cancun

description.text: In Cancun, this Puerto Morelos food walk leaves the hotel zone for a quieter fishing town south of the resort strip. A local guide leads a walking circuit of the plaza and waterfront, then stops for handmade tacos and an artesanal tequila tasting instead of a generic resort buffet. Fish, shrimp, smoked-meat, chicken, and vegetable taco options keep the food stop flexible, with a Mayan-style pork taco and a small ice-cream tasting rounding out the flavors. Hotel pickup and drop-off are included from most Cancun and Riviera Maya properties, so the afternoon stays on tasting and town walking rather than taxi logistics. The format suits visitors who want a native cultural food walk without coordinating restaurant reservations or tequila-room timing on their own. Departures are confirmed at booking in Cancun, and the itinerary stays on Puerto Morelos streets, taco counters, and tasting rooms that define this half-day from the hotel zone.
